delivery_cards.theme: ニットで重ねる、秋の新作
delivery_cards.copy: 重ねるほどに表情が変わる、やさしい手ざわりの新作ニットが届きました。
delivery_cards.instructions: メインビジュアルはニットの質感が伝わる近接のカットを全幅で配置し、温かみのあるベージュ〜ブラウン系で統一する。商品は上から順に、クルーネック、ケーブル、カーディガン、タートルの4点を2×2のグリッドで表示。余白を多めに取り、ボタンは落ち着いた濃色にして、素材の魅力を前面に出す。
delivery_cards.theme_reason: 10月初旬で肌寒くなる時期。売上上昇中のニット類が主役になる、季節感重視のテーマ。

delivery_cards.instructions: Lead with a full-width autumn outfit visual in warm brown and terracotta tones. Present outerwear first (Light Jacket, Trench Coat), then knits (Crewneck, Cable Knit) in a clean two-by-two rhythm. Keep generous white space and a calm, premium mood; make the call-to-action buttons quiet and dark.
delivery_cards.theme_reason: Early October brings cooler mornings and evenings; light jackets and knits are well stocked and trending up.

card_notes.author: Alex Kim
card_notes.body: Can we use the close-up of the cable knit for the hero instead of the full look?
card_notes.reply: Yes, but keep the warm tone. The full look can go in Section 1.

card_notes.author: Mika Tanaka
card_notes.body: Can you share a draft of the hero by Wednesday?

card_notes.author: Sam Ito
card_notes.body: Is the price in the email the sale price or the regular price?

card_notes.author: Sam Ito
card_notes.body: Should the countdown banner show hours or just "Ends Sunday"?
card_notes.reply: Just "Ends Sunday" — the banner is too small for a timer.

card_notes.body: Swap the hero to the cable knit close-up (keep the warm tone)
Move the full-look photo into Section 1

card_notes.author: Mika Tanaka
card_notes.body: The theme overlaps with the outerwear email two days earlier. Shift the angle to layering?

card_notes.author: Mika Tanaka
card_notes.body: メイン画像が前週と同じなので、別のカットにしてください。
card_notes.reply: メイン画像を、屋外のカットに差し替えました。

card_notes.author: Ken Sato
card_notes.body: Good point. Would "how to layer for chilly mornings" work as the angle?

card_notes.author: Mika Tanaka
card_notes.body: Yes, that works. Please also move the coat to the second section.

weeks.retro: Rainy Day Picks beat last year by a wide margin — keep one weather-led email per week. Flash Deal pushes at 6 PM drew fewer taps than the noon ones; try noon next time.

delivery_results.notes:
Worked: the warm-tone hero drew 31% of clicks.
Try next: put the best-selling knit in slot 1; slot 4 was weak.
Did not work: two similar jackets side by side split the clicks.

Worked: "Ends Sunday" in the headline lifted the click rate by 0.8pt.
Try next: show the discount on the product tiles.
Did not work: the hero without a model photo got fewer clicks than usual.
